text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm assembling the release notes for next week's docs deploy. Need a final pass on link-rot, SDK snippet parity (JS + Python), and the migration guide for v0.9 -> v1.0.

devon: Got it. What's the priority order?

nick: Link sweep > SDK parity > known-issues blurb. Found ~12 dead links under /guides and a couple of outdated anchors on /api.

nick: Quick find I used:
```bash
rg "http[s]?://" docs/ | grep -E "github.com|old-host.example.com" | wc -l
```

maria: Please open PRs with redirects where possible. If an upstream anchor changed, add an inline note in the doc and a redirect in netlify/_redirects.

aj: I can take JS snippets. There's a new streaming example that needs a server-side variant (no DOM). cc @devon for Python parity.

devon: I'll do Python variants. Where should canonical snippets live — /samples/snippets or the SDK repo? Prefer single-source-of-truth so builds pull the same file.

chris: FYI the docs toolchain still pulls from `main`. I ran `yarn build:docs` and it failed on one snippet missing a closing fence (file: integrations/s3.md).
```text
Error: Unclosed code block at integrations/s3.md:42
```

docs-bot: auto-check: 3 pages flagged for broken images (/integrations/s3, /deploy/private, /guides/quickstart). See ops/linkbot-2026-03-22 for details.

sam: For changelog entries, use the release-notes template at /docs/release-notes/template.md — include: short blurb, impact, migration steps, and a known-issue tag if applicable.

maria: I'll draft two blurbs: one for 'streaming response stability improvements' and one for 'routing fallback policy adjustment'. Will push PRs by EOD with sample snippets and migration steps.

nick: I'll open redirects PR for the 6 high-traffic pages this afternoon and add canonical links to the new paths. Assigning reviewers @aj @devon.

aj: Ack. I'll add JS snippet variants and mention the `client.stream()` fallback behavior in the examples.

devon: Adding Python sample using `with client.stream():` and a short note about tokenization changes in 1.0. Will ping for review once tests pass.

maria: :thumbsup: If anyone spots an SDK param rename or breaking change, call it out now so we can include clear migration steps.

chris: One more ask: add a known-issue entry: "Dedicated capacity cold-starts longer when cached kernels invalidated" — ops are aware, workaround = warm-up traffic, adding link to incident doc.

maria: Perfect — I'll add the workaround + link to the incident page and include an ops contact. Thanks everyone, tagging this for the release notes draft review tomorrow.
